_**Agent (2026-06-04 08:32:59Z)**_

Short answer: **not yet** — audio-to-text is planned but not implemented.

Here's the state of it in Atelier:

**What's documented/planned (but not built):**
- A **Whisper sidecar on port 8766** using `mlx-whisper` with `whisper-large-v3-turbo` (~1.6 GB)
- Planned endpoints: `POST /transcribe` (sync, short clips) and `POST /transcribe/batch` (hour-long inputs with SSE job tracking)
- A planned `transcribe(file) → text` wrapper in the media toolkit PRD
- Referenced in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/ATELIER.md` (marked **"planned"**), and `docs/PRD-atelier-media-toolkit.md`

**What's actually running today** — all of these are **TTS (text→audio)**, the opposite direction:
- OmniVoice (8770), Kokoro (8765), Dia 1.6B (8769)

So right now Atelier can do **text → speech**, but there's no **speech → text** sidecar yet. Per the architecture doc, Whisper was deliberately deferred until after Kokoro and the video-gen proof-of-concept.

Want me to scaffold the whisper sidecar (the `sidecars/whisper/` FastAPI service per the architecture spec)? It's a well-defined plan in the docs, so I could stand it up.

float, sep: str) -> str:\n    ms = int(round(seconds * 1000))\n    h, ms = divmod(ms, 3_600_000)\n    m, ms = divmod(ms, 60_000)\n    s, ms = divmod(ms, 1000)\n    return t0\n    # Telemetry line the governor ingests (one observable pane). audio_s is the\n    # natural ASR ETA unit (seconds of audio -> seconds of compute).\n    segs = result.get(\"segments\", [])\n    audio_s = segs[-1][\"end\"] if segs else 0.0\n    chars = len(result.get(\"text\", \"\"))\n    rtf = (audio_s / elapsed) if elapsed > 0 else 0.0\n    print(f\"[asr] audio_s={audio_s:.1f} chars={chars} bytes={audio_bytes} \"\n          f\"{elapsed:.2f}s rtf={rtf:.1f}x lang={result.get('language')}\", flush=True)\n    return result, elapsed\n\n\n# ---------- HTTP: health ----------\n@app.get(\"/healthz\")\ndef healthz():\n    return {\"ok\": True, \"service\": \"whisper\", \"model\": MODEL_REPO, \"version\": \"1.0\"}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/readyz\")\ndef readyz():\n    state = \"warm\" if _loaded else \"cold\"\n    lifecycle = \"cold\" if not _loaded else (\"busy\" if _active > 0 else \"idle\")\n    return {\n        \"ok\": True,\n        \"state\": state,\n        \"lifecycle\": lifecycle,\n        \"busy\": _active > 0,\n        \"active_jobs\": _active,\n        \"queue_depth\": _waiting,\n        \"warmed\": _loaded,\n        \"model\": MODEL_REPO,\n        \"device\": \"mps\",\n        \"batch_jobs\": len(_jobs),\n        \"idle_seconds\": round(time.monotonic() - 0 and not force:\n        return {\"unloaded\": False, \"refused\": \"busy\", \"active_jobs\": _active}\n    was_loaded = _loaded\n    if was_loaded:\n        async with _sem:\n            await _unload_model()\n    return {\"unloaded\": was_loaded, \"forced\": force, \"model\": MODEL_REPO}\n\n\n# ---------- HTTP: sync transcribe ----------\n@app.post(\"/transcribe\")\nasync def transcribe(\n Form(default=None),\n    initial_prompt: str | None = Form(default=None),\n    word_timestamps: bool = Form(default=False),\n    response_format: str = Form(default=\"json\"),\n    save: bool =
